title: Matching and geometry: ratio test, DLT and RANSAC
summary: Pair descriptors with the ratio test, fit a similarity and your own normalised DLT homography, find them among wrong pairs with RANSAC and write NAVERA's trust gates — then match with the neural network you trained in mission 21: decide its threshold from measurements, measure where it beats SIFT and where it fails, and write the matcher's policy.
